note: Game posters, keyed by the DBBF game id. Entered by hand. tools/build-fixtures.py rewrites fixtures.json from the CSV on every run and never touches this file, so a poster survives a fixture rebuild. talata-fixtures.js fetches this beside fixtures.json; if it is missing or broken the fixtures still render and the cup popup falls back to text. To add the next poster: export the graphic at 1080x1350 into /images/games/, save a half size copy with a -540 suffix, then add one entry below under the game id from fixtures.json with img, thumb, w, h, alt, article and label. The thumb is read as half of w and h. The og key is the 1200x630 share card for the article and is optional.
